q_wake.speaker: Q
q_wake.text: There you are. I was about to poke you with this pen.

greeting.speaker: YOU
greeting.text: He says it as if this is an old routine.

greet_question.speaker: Q
greet_question.text: Very funny. We sat together all last term. You even borrowed my pen.

greet_polite.speaker: Q
greet_polite.text: Only for a minute. You always come back just when I get to the interesting bit.

greet_firm.speaker: Q
greet_firm.text: Fine, fine. I'll save my pen for someone more appreciative.

q_term.speaker: Q
q_term.text: First day of the final term and you're sleeping through biology already. That's impressive, even for you.

q_exam.speaker: Q
q_exam.text: After the last biology exam, I thought you'd be worried. Didn't you leave half of it blank? I barely finished mine.

q_teacher.speaker: Q
q_teacher.text: Ms B usually takes this lesson. If she spots a mistake, the whole room gets to hear about it. Her old set square is still up front, look.

memory_choice.speaker: YOU
memory_choice.text: The exam is difficult to put in order.

choices.text: I can't place it at all.
I think I was holding a pen.

memory_blank.speaker: Q
memory_blank.text: Lucky you. I remember the clock more clearly than the questions.

memory_pen.speaker: Q
memory_pen.text: Well, that's a start. Mine stopped working halfway through, naturally.

memory_later.speaker: Q
memory_later.text: All right. We can put that subject back to sleep too.

q_bag.speaker: Q
q_bag.text: Anyway, did you bring your biology book? Mine's under all this paper somewhere.

wake_observation.speaker: YOU NOTICE
wake_observation.text: Your head aches. Your sleeve is creased against the desk.

teacher_choice.speaker: YOU
teacher_choice.text: What do you make of Q's description of B?

teacher_ask.speaker: Q
teacher_ask.text: Not always. That's just how I remember the last few lessons.

teacher_challenge.speaker: Q
teacher_challenge.text: I'm impressed she can spot a wrong answer from the back of the room. Not that I volunteer them.

teacher_change.speaker: Q
teacher_change.text: All right, all right. There are other things to worry about.

open.speaker: YOU NOTICE
open.text: The zip catches, then opens. A pencil case and a folded timetable, but no biology textbook.

q_notice.speaker: Q
q_notice.text: No book? I wouldn't announce that if B walks in.

choices.text: Don't make a thing of it.

book_share.speaker: Q
book_share.text: Sure, if you can see around my elbow. It's a very important elbow.

book_explain.speaker: Q
book_explain.text: All right. I'm keeping my copy open either way.

book_avoid.speaker: Q
book_avoid.text: I wasn't going to announce it. I'll only mention it to my elbow.

imagining.speaker: YOU
imagining.text: For a moment, you picture having to explain the missing textbook at the teacher's desk. It is only a possibility; you don't know who will arrive or what they would say.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: The bag still holds a pencil case and a timetable. The biology textbook is still missing.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: A wooden set square lies on the teacher's desk. One corner is chipped.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: The chipped set square is where you left it. Looking at it tells you nothing about who last used it.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: BIOLOGY is written at the top of the board. The line below it has been rubbed away.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: Pale light comes through the window. One latch has a different screw from the others.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: The clock is running. There is still a little time before the lesson.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: The clock is running. N's free period has already begun.

first.speaker: Q
first.text: Your bag's right there. No rush. Well, a little rush, maybe.

share.speaker: Q
share.text: If we need the book, you can look at mine. Just don't fold the corner.

explain.speaker: Q
explain.text: You can explain it yourself. I'll try not to listen too obviously.

avoid.speaker: Q
avoid.text: I'm not making a thing of it. See? Not a word.

released.speaker: Q
released.text: Well. I could have slept in too. I'm staying here for a bit.

fallback.speaker: Q
fallback.text: I hope I brought the right book, at least.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: The classroom door is closed. The lesson hasn't started.

n_arrives.speaker: N
n_arrives.text: Ms B isn't here today. I'm N, covering her class.

n_books.speaker: N
n_books.text: Could you take out your books? Please. One conversation at a time.

room_noise.speaker: YOU NOTICE
room_noise.text: Chairs scrape. The talking continues. N waits, then looks down at the register.

n_again.speaker: N
n_again.text: I did ask for quiet. All right—free activity for the rest of the period. You may leave, but keep the corridor clear. I need to finish this register.

q_after.speaker: Q
q_after.text: Huh. I thought B would be here. I could have stayed asleep.

n_seen.speaker: YOU NOTICE
n_seen.text: A young teacher steps into the room and pauses by the desk.

first.speaker: N
first.text: Free activity. Please don't gather in the doorway; I'm still working.

first.speaker: YOU NOTICE
first.text: Daylight reaches the school exit. The textbook is still missing, and the way ahead is open.
